what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 892037 Somali refugees, and Kenya hosts the largest share, 35.8%.
Ethiopia hosts almost as many, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in several periods since 1982.
From 1986 to 1996 the groups fighting the government include the SNM, the SPM and the USC/SNA, at war level in 1988 and from 1990 to 1992.
From 2006 to 2025 they include Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam, at war level in most years since 2007.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 1991 to 1997 and 2009 to 2025.
UNHCR's figure peaked at 1136709 in 2012 and fell to 776678 by 2021.
Returns to Somalia were highest in 1993 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees; asylum seekers from Somalia are counted in a separate series.
People displaced inside Somalia are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
